hotels.title: Austin Boutique Luxury near Rainey Street with Rooftop Pool, Daily Dining Credit & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: Soak up Austin’s effortlessly cool atmosphere with a stay at the utterly stylish Hotel Van Zandt - a boutique haven where captivating Southern charm meets laid-back luxury. Perfectly positioned in the heart of the buzzing Rainey Street Historic District, this downtown escape places you just steps from bungalow-style bars, iconic food trucks and legendary live music venues. Start your mornings with breakfast at Geraldine's restaurant where smooth jazz sets the tone, spend afternoons lounging by the heated rooftop pool with city views stretching out below, then venture out to explore Sixth Street's live music venues or South Congress Avenue's quirky shops. Return for craft cocktails at the Brass Poppy Cocktail Lounge or head straight to the trendy rooftop to soak up the city's electric energy from above. This is true Southern hospitality with Austin's signature edge.

hotels.title: Modern Downtown Austin Mid-Century Stay with Restaurant, Bar & Coffee Shop
hotels.description: Enjoy being steps from Austin's lively 6th Street Entertainment District with a relaxing stay at this refreshed retreat in the heart of the city's Downtown. Before you set out for the day, grab a quick coffee and buttery pastry at President's House Coffee. Between Texan adventures, take a dip in the hotel's sparkling rooftop pool, sip margaritas while overlooking the skyline at Cloud Bar, or sit down to enjoy casual eats at Capital A.
